preview: Surendrakumar Pandey shares his on-campus interview experience at Tata Digital for the Digital Developer role, detailing the online test, three interview rounds, and preparation tips.
content: Tata Digital Interview Experience On-Campus Surendrakumar Pandey B.Tech Comps VJTI 2022 Tata digital visited our campus in August 2021 to hire final year students for the role of Digital Developer. Their criteria were: CPI 7 and above, 70% and above in 10th and 12th. Online Test: The online test was conducted on the Hackerrank Platform. The test was for 90 mins. There were 3 Mcq questions and 3 coding questions one coding question was easy and 2 were medium-difficult level questions: 1) Given an array of n elements, and 1 operation which we can perform on the array. a) Operation: Except one Increase all the elements of the array by 1. b) The task was to find the minimum number of this kind of operations required to make all the array elements equal. 2) I don’t remember this question properly but it was quite easy. 3) Given a string that consists of space-separated words find the number of valid words in that string. a) A valid word is a word that consists of alphanumeric characters only. The last word in the string had one exception, so it can have any punctuation mark as its last character apart from normal alphanumeric characters. I was not able to solve the first question but I solved 2nd and 3rd completely so I got selected for the next round. First Interview round: Two interviewers were taking this round simultaneously and it was about 45 minutes long. The questions were following: 1) Introduce yourself. 2) Which theory subjects do you know.(I answerd OS, DBMS, OOPS, Networking) 3) What is the name of the first and last layer of the OSI model. 4) What is the difference between TCP and UDP, explain it with real world example? 5) What is OS? Is it software or hardware? 6) What is deadlock? Why it happens and how can we avoid that? 7) What is DBMS? 8) What is normalization and why do we need it? 9) What is indexing? What are the types of indexes? Then the first interviewer asked the second one to ask the questions from then onwards. I suppose the second interviewer was there to ask me about OOP’s and problem-solving. 10) What languages do I know? 11) Explain inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and abstraction in java. (Even though I was not knowing java too well but luckily I was able to answer all of them). 12) Suppose a package is given that consists of 3 classes A, B, C. B is public and A, C are private. Can I access B from A or C? 13) What are the types of access specifiers? What is the difference between private and protected access specifiers? 14) Suppose classes A and B are present in a package and a variable varA which is private variable is present in class A I want to access that in class B how can I do that? Without any inheritance? 15) What the previous question was example of, encapsulation or abstraction? 16) Then he asked me egg drop puzzle with the number of eggs equal to 2. 17) Finally faulty brick puzzle. In this round I was not able to answer the 15th question clearly. And also I got stuck in egg drop puzzle but interviewers were friendly so they gave me hints and I was able to solve it. A tip would be that, be confident about your answers don’t hesitate too much. I was asked 5th question twice but I gave the anwer quickly both times. The interview was conducted on microsoft teams. I got a call after 2 hours that my next round interview is scheduled in 30 minutes. Round 2 Interview: Again two interviewers were taking this round simultaneously and it was about 30 minutes long. The questions were following: 1) Introduce yourself. 2) Explain the projects on your resume. 3) What technologies and languages do you know? 4) Which technologies do you know other than those mentioned on resume? 5) What are your expectations from tata digital? 6) What is your opinion about the e-commerce industry growth in India in the future? 7) Where do you see yourself 5 years down the line? 8) What are your hobbies? (I mentioned cricket) 9) Since I said I live in Mumbai so they asked me what is the best thing you like about Mumbai? Here the tip would be to listen the PPT carefully. They had told in the PPT that they will train freshers for first 6 months about various technologies. So I accordingly answered the 5th question that my expectation is to get industry level training and exposure. Round 3 Interview: It was a telephonic round. 1) What were the names of the interviewers from the previous round? 2) How were the previous round experience and any suggestion for improvement? 3) What do you know about tata digital and tata industries in general? 4) Are you excited about working here at Tata digital? If so why? Here the tip would be to read about the key achievements of the company. Major leaders in the company and the core values of the company. I luckily read about that and was able to answer 3rd and 4th question accordingly.
